old_identity.memory_query_semantics: SMI physical UUID/rounded memory separate from torch logical cuda:0/properties. Do not demand byte equality between the two interfaces; require one visible logical device mapped via the fixed UUID and record torch capacity.

proposed_identity.memory_query_semantics: SMI physical UUID/rounded memory separate from torch logical cuda:0/properties. Do not demand byte equality between the two interfaces; require one visible logical device mapped via the fixed UUID and record torch capacity.

required_unchanged: All other identity fields, selected 30 asset hashes, static scientific config, data/source/fold, common order, model/provider/backends, training lifecycle and 3900-step/resource contract

implementation_proposal.contract_bootstrap: New hash-pinned sibling v2 contract loaded under existing logical API name; require exact new __file__, no fallback.
implementation_proposal.request_schema: New v2 schema adds exact resource_rebind file record; no real training request exists yet, no training attempt consumed.
implementation_proposal.environment: Only CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES expected value derives from exact new identity; all other frozen scope environment expectations unchanged.
implementation_proposal.receipt: Only after separate implementation authorization; binds old/new evidence and unchanged science hashes, never future code/P3/request/auth/runtime hashes.
implementation_proposal.overlay: Small side-by-side supplement after implementation/P3; preserve original 327 mapped files and original data archive.

historical_GPU_policy.remaining_decision: Any future attempt without new-GPU empirical validation must explicitly disclose migration uncertainty in the new request and obtain separate user acceptance/execution authority. If user instead requires new-device empirical admission, a separate minimal fixed verification protocol/authorization is required.

hash_DAG: Old scope/GPU evidence + new readonly report + immutable science hashes -> rebind receipt -> new entry/contract hashes -> CPU/P3 -> small overlay / future pending request -> separate authorization -> runtime. No reverse edges.

frozen_resource_budgets.monitoring: Pre-step RSS/time/output/free-disk checks; post-step allocator/device/PID checks; two final-save checks. Maximum 3902 resource records; external timeout mandatory. Cooperative, not a cgroup/hard-isolation guarantee.
frozen_resource_budgets.budget_basis: 24h is a finite conservative engineering allowance for the fixed 3900 updates, not a runtime extrapolation from two artificial forwards and not a completion guarantee. Output cap 2GiB and minimum free 4GiB are explicit stopping reserves, not a measured checkpoint-size certificate. Memory ceilings inherit the approved implementation; AdamW/ordinary BN memory remains to be observed only during separately authorized training.
